name: @unej-cms/theme-joy
description: Joy: a bold, general-purpose UNEJ CMS theme — vivid hero, stat counters, dropdown mega-nav, and scroll-reveal animations. Every number and label is a theme setting (not hardcoded academic copy), and the homepage hero/stats/program-card section ships as an editable Page Builder pattern rather than baked-in markup, so a site can start as a campus page and later be repurposed for something else entirely (an esports/community portal, for example) without touching theme code. Authored as real Svelte components, rendered via Svelte SSR (apps/backend's SvelteSiteRenderer).
